Brief:
You are preparing the project at /Users/alexwaldmann/Desktop/rui for autonomous work. Before SARA starts dispatching worklist items to you and others, verify and document:

1. **Environment**: The project builds and runs cleanly in isolation. Check PATH, credentials (.env if needed), system dependencies, installed packages.
2. **Credentials & Secrets**: Any API keys, GitHub tokens, or credentials needed are in place and working. Verify with a quick test if possible.
3. **Build System**: The build (npm install, cargo build, poetry install, etc.) completes without errors. Document the build command.
4. **Test Suite**: Run the existing test suite if one exists. Fix any pre-existing failures (they block detection of new breakage).
5. **Development Setup**: Editor config, linters, formatters, git hooks all working. Commit setup changes if any were needed.
6. **Documentation**: index.dx or README clearly states:
   - How to build and test this project
   - Where to find the actual code entry points
   - What the main moving parts are
   - Any project-specific rules or conventions

Do not implement features or fix bugs — setup is verification only. If something is broken or unclear, fix it enough that the next worker gets a clean slate. Commit your work (or note what you could not fix). When done, say "Setup complete" to mark this project ready.

plan.title: **Verify Rust version meets 1.85+ minimum**
plan.body: Test that `rustc` is installed and version check passes. Reads version string, compares against documented minimum from CLAUDE.md.

plan.title: **Verify platform-specific system dependencies**
plan.body: Detect OS (macOS/Linux/Windows), verify required headers present. On macOS check for Xcode tools; on Linux verify X11 headers; on Windows check WinAPI availability.
plan.acceptance: `cargo build --target $(rustc -vV | grep host: | awk '{print $2}') 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -q "Finished" && echo "✓ Platform OK"`

plan.title: **Clean build from scratch, verify no errors**
plan.body: Remove build artifacts, rebuild all targets to ensure no stale state. Captures final build output line.
plan.acceptance: `cargo clean && cargo build 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -q "Finished\|error" && cargo build 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -q "Finished"` succeeds

plan.title: **Run full test suite, document pre-existing failures**
plan.body: Execute `cargo test` and `cargo test --test setup` to identify any failing tests. If tests fail, diagnose root cause (missing dep, broken import, hook issue) and fix in-place.
plan.acceptance: `cargo test 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -q "test result: ok"` or failures fixed and re-run succeeds

plan.title: **Verify pre-commit hook is installed and executable**
plan.body: Check that `.git/hooks/pre-commit` exists, is executable, and runs without error. Manually execute hook to verify formatters and linters fire.

plan.title: **Run formatters and linters to completion, fix all warnings**
plan.body: Execute `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`. If either fails, run `cargo fmt` to auto-fix formatting, then `cargo clippy --fix --allow-staged` to auto-fix clippy warnings.
plan.acceptance: `cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -q "warning: 0\|error: 0"` succeeds silently

plan.title: **Create `.doc/index.dx` with verified build, test, and example commands**
plan.body: Write single .dx document indexing project structure, build commands, test commands, and key examples from CLAUDE.md. Reference entry points (counter, segmented exemplars) and module dependencies.
plan.acceptance: `test -f .doc/index.dx && grep -q "cargo build\|cargo test\|cargo run" .doc/index.dx && echo "✓ Index OK"`

plan.title: **Build and run counter example end-to-end locally**
plan.body: Build counter example in release mode, launch app, verify window opens and responds to input (click increment button, verify state updates).
plan.acceptance: `cargo build --release -p rui --example counter 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -q "Finished"` and manual launch succeeds

plan.title: **Verify WASM build target compiles without errors**
plan.body: Ensure `wasm32-unknown-unknown` target is installed and builds. Cross-compile counter example to WASM to verify no platform-specific breakage.
plan.acceptance: `rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p rui --example counter 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -q "Finished"`

plan.title: **Record final setup state, mark project ready for autonomous dispatch**
plan.body: Create `.engine/setup-verified.txt` with timestamp, Rust version, platform, build command, test count, and verification checklist. Commit .doc/index.dx and setup record.
plan.acceptance: `test -f .engine/setup-verified.txt && git add -A && git commit -m "setup: verify build, tests, hooks, docs for autonomous dispatch" && git log --oneline | head -1 | grep -q "setup"` succeeds
